benmore verify [dir] [--app NAME] [--quick|--release] [--json] [--reason "why"]   # --reason goes with every journey that signs in as a user; an app with compliance: hipaa requires it for such journeys (api(at:"compliance.workforce_reads"))
benmore ship [dir] --promote [--reason "why"]   # interactive terminal required; release verification (with the same --reason), then explicit production confirmation
